content: {"like":["Prefers visually stunning, artful cinematography with CGI and glass painting.","Values strong, character-driven narratives with emotional depth.","Enjoys powerful, well-acted casts featuring both veterans and newcomers.","Loves films that merge style with substantive themes, often Shakespearean.","Appreciates thoughtful, multi-layered storytelling with moral or historical significance."],"dislike":["Dislikes shallow, superficial films lacking emotional resonance.","Avoids movies with contrived or mannequin-like performances.","Rejects excessive campiness or over-violent content.","Prefers pacing that balances drama without unnecessary length.","Dislikes films that prioritize style over substance or depth."]}
